--DROP TABLE dbo.revenue_copy_demo;

CREATE TABLE dbo.revenue_copy_demo
(
    Dealer_ID VARCHAR(4000),
    Model_ID VARCHAR(4000),
    Branch_ID VARCHAR(4000),
    Date_ID VARCHAR(4000),
    Units_Sold BIGINT,
    Revenue BIGINT
)
WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN
);


COPY INTO dbo.revenue_copy_demo
(
    Dealer_ID 1,
    Model_ID 2,
    Branch_ID 3,
    Date_ID 4,
    Units_Sold 5,
    Revenue 6
)
FROM 'https://sasynapsedemo.dfs.core.windows.net/enriched/cetas_revenue_2/'
WITH
(
    FILE_TYPE = 'PARQUET',
    CREDENTIAL = (IDENTITY = 'Managed Identity')
);

SELECT * FROM dbo.revenue_copy_demo;
